news.title: outages that hit Microsoft, Apple, FAA, JPMorgan, other US systems in a week
news.description: Recent outages affecting US tech systems, including Apple and Microsoft, have been deemed unrelated by officials. Secretary of State Marco Rubio expressed that there is no evidence linking these disruptions to cyberattacks or malicious actors. The Federal Aviation Administration experienced a nationwide ground stop, impacting air travel significantly. Other services such as Charles Schwab and JPMorgan Chase faced disruptions but were attributed to technical issues.

news.title: Charles Schwab resolves brief website loading issue, says trading remained available
news.description: Charles Schwab Corp experienced a brief loading issue on their website that has now been resolved. Trading services continued to remain available throughout this disruption for clients. Users were able to access their accounts via the website or the Schwab Mobile app. The company issued an apology for the inconvenience caused by the technical problem. Overall, clients experienced minimal disruption during this period of website maintenance.

news.title: Aster DM Quality Care certifies fractional share payout for QCIL amalgamation
news.description: Aster DM Quality Care Limited certified the distribution of net proceeds from fractional shares to former Quality Care India Limited shareholders. The company sold 65 consolidated fractional shares at an average price of ₹676.0669 per share on October 8, 2026. Net sale proceeds of ₹43,834.43 were available for distribution after deducting brokerage and statutory charges. An amount of ₹1,886.45 relating to eight shareholders remains undistributed due to failed remittances and is held by the company.
